name: marketing-council

en.description: When the user wants multiple expert perspectives on a marketing question — a simulated board of advisors staffed by legendary marketers (Seth Godin, David Ogilvy, Eugene Schwartz, April Dunford, Rory Sutherland, Alex Hormozi, Byron Sharp, and more).

zh-CN.description: 从多个经典营销框架分析同一问题，呈现分歧并综合形成可执行建议。

runtime: No helper runtime required; web, analytics, media, or account tools are optional and task-dependent

stableBlockers: Run blind review on three representative real tasks
Validate platform-specific guidance and external-action recovery
